### Open Mic

![open-mic](open-mic-dec.jpg)

Open mic night returns to the NCF! Whether it's music, poetry, comedy, or storytelling, the stage is open for you. Sign-up begins at 9PM, and performances start at 10PM. Guitars (right- and left-handed) will be available. The evening will be hosted by Seán Gorman and Joe Clarke — come along for a relaxed night of creativity, fun, and community spirit. Free event!

### Event Details

* **Date:** Saturday 22th November 2025
* **Time:** 9pm
* **Location:** TheNCF Collective, 5 Pearse Street, Upstairs. 
* **Admission:** Free

*Presented by theNCF*
